Beacon-bound reveal deposits. A new identity posts a 2.00-unit jade escrow and a hash commitment upfront.
How it runs: at epoch E+10 the beacon reveals R; identities publish secrets within 5 epochs; hash(secret, R) under 1/16 of range triggers a full audit, unrevealed escrows burn. Audited identities leave a relic record blocking re-escrow for 20 epochs.
Attacker cost: 16 sybils lock 32.00 units; 1 in 16 is audited per epoch, burning 2.00 units plus a 0.25-unit ripple fee on its referrer. Over 12 epochs the fleet burns 24 units, so sybils lose money net.
